title: ee.cursor.v1
description: Continuation-cursor payload for output-token-governed list surfaces (ADR 0063 §3). The wire form is opaque: base64url(payload).base64url(blake3_mac), where the MAC is a keyed BLAKE3 over the canonical payload bytes using a deterministic per-workspace key (BLAKE3 derive_key with context 'ee.cursor.v1 workspace mac key v1' over the workspace scope string). This document describes the decoded payload object. Cursors never embed secrets or raw query text; paramsHash is a BLAKE3 of the normalized invocation parameters. Resuming with a MAC or paramsHash mismatch yields the cursor_invalid degraded code; resuming after the workspace DB generation advanced yields cursor_stale (repair for both: re-run without --cursor).

targetSchema.description: Schema id of the governed response the cursor continues (e.g. ee.search.v1). Surfaces identified only by data.command use the ee.command:<command> form.

dbGeneration.description: Workspace DB generation the page sequence was issued at. Pages must partition exactly one generation's result set (no duplicates, no gaps); a lower value than the current generation is rejected as cursor_stale, a higher value as cursor_invalid.

positionKey.description: Stable ordered-position key of the last emitted element at the declared truncation point (the element's registered key field, falling back to its original array index).

paramsHash.description: BLAKE3 of the length-prefixed normalized query/filter parameters, excluding the governor's own flags so the same query at a different ceiling stays resumable.
